topics.title: Don Kirshner Discusses Talent Search & Mishaps
topics.summary: During an interview, Don Kirshner discusses his attempts to discover new talent through contests like Tangerine Dream and evaluates a band, ‘John’s Band,’ noting the lead singer's potential but criticizing their production. He recounts offering substantial sums of money after riots and shares anecdotes about Ricky Carmichael and Rodney King, including observations on celebrity behavior.

topics.title: Dice’s Chaotic Night at the Tonight Show
topics.summary: During an interview, Dice recounts a bizarre evening involving a soap opera fan named Michael Swan attempting to disrupt taping of the Tonight Show by criticizing Edward James and rumors about Robin. The episode also included confused attempts to book NPR personnel, discussions surrounding Richard Simmons' sex tapes, and arguments between producers.”}​ 39 words”**

topics.title: Howard Disputes NPR Booking & Hollywood Demands
topics.summary: During a late-night talk show segment, Howard expresses frustration with the potential booking of an NPR guest and criticizes perceived attempts to appeal to women by focusing solely on stereotypical imagery like short skirts. He dismisses concerns about audience demographics, emphasizing his desire for engaging conversations and rejecting Hollywood’s demands for spectacle or celebrity endorsements.

topics.title: Stallone Family Phone Argument
topics.summary: During a phone interview, Howard and his co-hosts engage in a heated argument with Jackie Stallone’s senior regarding her relationship with her grandson. Filled with colorful language and personal criticisms about Frank Stallone's lack of ambition and perceived disrespect, the discussion reveals longstanding family tensions.

topics.title: Domestic Dispute and Potato Jokes
topics.summary: A heated discussion unfolds between two individuals regarding accusations of abuse involving a woman and her husband, including canning mishaps. The conversation shifts to an unrelated comedic segment featuring impressions centered around stereotypes about Iranians and their perceived comments about testicles.

topics.title: Potato Jokes and Radio City Farts
topics.summary: During the broadcast, callers discuss their gas issues while attending movie showings at Radio City Music Hall, recounting awkward interactions stemming from flatulence. One caller even describes recording farts for commercial purposes, leading to a chaotic exchange about Scott's job documenting these sounds.
